title: feat(notifications): push device registry — sys_user_device, the two device routes and the client methods
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Steve, Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8Ku7jRvrz4ma8UUATyNH88K)_

Fixes #29068

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. 改了什么：手机推送设备登记上线了——新表 `sys_user_device`，新接口 `POST /api/v1/notifications/devices`（登记/刷新）和 `DELETE /api/v1/notifications/devices/:deviceId`（注销自己的设备），客户端恢复 `notifications.registerDevice` / `unregisterDevice`。
2. 为什么改：#29067 已把契约定好但标着“计划中、未提供”，推送渠道没有地方取设备令牌；这次把四个服务方法和两条路由真正接上，去掉 PLANNED 标记。
3. 风险与回滚：只新增，不改已有行为；设备表是系统表，通用数据接口读写都拒绝（404 OBJECT_API_DISABLED），未登录 401，删别人的设备 404 且不删；回滚即还原本 PR，新表无人引用。
4. 先看：`service-messaging/src/device-registry.ts`（令牌唯一、换人接管、失效后重新启用），再看 `runtime/src/domains/notifications.ts` 的设备分支。
5. 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run src/device-registry.integration.test.ts` 和 dogfood `test/push-device-registry.dogfood.test.ts`，两者全绿。
6. 需要你做的：无;三个实现选择已由合同评审 6590640619 全部定为 A,令牌长度上限(评审 S3)是收窄,另走 spec 卡。席位意见:第 3 轮契约复核 PASS(6593441550),CI 全绿,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/service-messaging`**
  - New `sys_user_device` (`src/objects/user-device.object.ts`): engine-owned, `tenancy: { enabled: false }` (a device belongs to its user, not to an organization, so no injected `organization_id`), `enable: { apiEnabled: false, apiMethods: [] }`, `user_id` a `sys_user` lookup with cascade delete, unique indexes on `(user_id, device_id)` and on `token`. `nameField: 'name'` only (no `titleFormat`, per #29499 which landed during this card).
  - New `DeviceRegistry` (`src/device-registry.ts`) behind `MessagingService`'s four `INotificationService` members: `registerDevice` (refresh a held device id, mint one when absent, move a token another device holds to the registering device and remove the previous holder's row, re-enable an invalidated device; the takeover delete of the previous holder and the registering write run in one engine transaction where the engine offers one, so a refused write rolls the delete back (the module docblock names the window on an engine without one); `REGISTER_ATTEMPTS` is 3, and a writer that still loses a cross-node unique-index race sees `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, the stated ceiling), `unregisterDevice` (the caller's own device, else `NOT_FOUND` 404 and nothing removed), `listDevices` (the caller's, newest `last_seen_at` first), `invalidateDeviceToken` (row kept, `enabled: false` + `invalidated_at`). Vendor derives from platform (ios→apns, android→fcm); a `web` registration without `vendor` is refused `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` at `vendor`.
  - The plugin registers and provisions the table; translation bundles regenerated (zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES translated by hand).
- **`@objectstack/runtime`**
  - `/notifications` domain: `POST /devices` (body parsed with `RegisterDeviceRequestSchema`, owner always the session user, a body `userId` is never read) and `DELETE /devices/:deviceId` (segment decoded; a malformed escape is passed raw, i.e. an unknown id → 404). Both sit behind the domain's anonymous floor (401). Each face probes its own service member, so a provider without the device members answers 501 and one without an inbox still serves them.
  - `dispatcher-plugin.ts` mounts both on the standalone server, and the other verbs on the two paths refusal-only (the #24024 pattern the inbox faces use).
  - `route-ledger.ts`: the two SDK rows plus eight server-only refusal rows. The device refusal rows say 404 with or without an inbox and 501 only without a notification service, pinned in `notifications-devices.test.ts`.
- **`@objectstack/client`**: `notifications.registerDevice(request)` and `notifications.unregisterDevice(deviceId)` (id `encodeURIComponent`-ed) are back.
- **`@objectstack/spec`** (the four allowed hunks): `DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_ROUTES` lists the two device routes (+ `methods` entries) with the comment rewritten; the `[PLANNED — not yet served]` markers and their "marker comes off" comments leave the four registration schemas and `UserDeviceSchema`; `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE` gains `sys_user_device`; `error-code-ledger.zod.ts` lists `NOT_FOUND` under `@objectstack/service-messaging` with its wire path (`unregisterDevice`, `deviceNotFoundError`, `DELETE /api/v1/notifications/devices/:deviceId` answers 404 through `resolveThrownHttpError`), the hunk contract review 6590640619 allowed. Generated reference docs regenerated.
- Census last: `organization-ownership-inventory.ts` row and `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json` regenerated (sys_user_device: tenancy disabled, reach out). The tenant-audit census (`content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` and `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md`) is regenerated for the registry's five engine write sites (256 → 261 on the current main), with the page's hand-written figures moved to match; the platform-object tenancy census is registered 92 → 93, outOfReach 45 → 46, `tenancy.enabled: false` 2 → 3, and lists both `sys_personal_view` (#29575) and `sys_user_device`; the route-ledger census sentence moves 116 → 126.
- No GET route (the card says so); `listDevices` is service-only for the push channel.

### Forced test edits

- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service-plugin.test.ts`: both OBJECTS lists gain `sys_user_device`.
- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/translations/bundle-ownership.test.ts`: the owned-object list gains `sys_user_device`.
- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.routes.test.ts`: the refusal-mount pin covers five faces × five verbs (count 15 → 25).
- `packages/runtime/src/request-schema-gate.conformance.test.ts`: the ratchet demands a violating-body case for the new catalog row with a request schema; a `registerDevice` spy and the case are added.
- `packages/spec/src/api/plugin-rest-api.test.ts`: the default notification routes pin flips to five endpoints including both device routes.
- `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.test.ts`: the service-messaging roster pin names `sys_user_device` (forced by the roster hunk; review must-fix 2).
- `packages/spec/src/api/register-device-request.test.ts`, `packages/spec/src/system/push-device.test.ts`: the "carries the PLANNED marker" pins flip to "carries no PLANNED marker".

## Tests

New: `device-registry.integration.test.ts` (10, real ObjectQL + SqlDriver + `sys_user`; the tenth: a takeover whose write is refused rolls the previous holder's delete back), `objects/user-device.object.test.ts` (4), `runtime/src/domains/notifications-devices.test.ts` (7), two client tests, and `packages/qa/dogfood/test/push-device-registry.dogfood.test.ts` (7, the real showcase stack: anonymous 401 on both routes, register/refresh, non-owner unregister 404 with the row surviving, token takeover, invalidate then re-register, body/vendor 400, and the generic data API refused `404 OBJECT_API_DISABLED` on list/read/create/patch/delete for a member).

Red first, on the base: service-messaging fails to resolve the registry; runtime 6 of 14 fail across the new device-face file and the conformance case (the two anonymous cases pass on base because the domain's floor already refuses anonymous; the A4 ablation is what pins them); client 2 fail plus `route-ledger-coverage` "every ledger entry naming a client method resolves".

Ablations (each via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored with `git diff HEAD` empty):

| # | Mutation | Red |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | `unregister` drops the `user_id` filter | non-owner unregister case |
| A2 | takeover no longer deletes the previous holder | 3 registry cases |
| A3 | `web` derives `apns` | vendor case |
| A4 | the domain's anonymous floor skipped | both anonymous dispatcher cases |
| A5 | owner read from the body `userId` | "registers for the session user" |
| A6 | `apiEnabled` true, `apiMethods` removed; service-messaging rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in dist | dogfood `[data-api]` (the permission layer then answers 403, not the exposure gate's 404); restored, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` ✓, file 7/7 |
| A7 | the registration transaction removed | a takeover whose write is refused rolls the previous holder's delete back; restored with `git diff HEAD` empty |

## Acceptance notes and deviations

- **Changesets are all `patch`**, not the minors the card's delta suggested: `Metadata-protocol` measures `none`, and the changeset gate refuses `minor` with `none`.
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/notification-service.ts`: a comment-only change (the members are now implemented by service-messaging), outside the three named spec hunks; it would otherwise state the opposite of what ships.
- The `methods` array entries in `DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_ROUTES` ride with hunk 1's two route rows.
- A fourth spec hunk: the `NOT_FOUND` row in `error-code-ledger.zod.ts`, allowed by review 6590640619.
- Review S3 (`RegisterDeviceRequestSchema.token` unbounded while `sys_user_device.token` stores at most 512) stays out of this PR: a narrowing, for a spec follow-up card.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` is untouched.

## Open questions (ruled: A on all three, kept, by contract review 6590640619)

1. Cross-node token race: a unique index on `token` plus one retry on a unique violation, beside an in-process per-token lock. Options: A keep (the database is the arbiter across nodes); B add a distributed lock. Recommendation A.
2. `user_id` is a `sys_user` lookup with `deleteBehavior: 'cascade'`, so deleting a user removes their devices. Options: A keep; B `set_null` and sweep. Recommendation A: a device row without a user can never receive a push.
3. `DELETE /devices/:deviceId` with a malformed percent-escape answers 404 (the raw segment is an unknown id) rather than 400. Options: A keep; B refuse 400. Recommendation A: the caller learns nothing about other users' ids either way.

## Verification

Head `3cabcf90` (origin/main merged at `e0187d0f`, clean, no overlap with the PR's 44 files; no authored change in round 3).

- cli unit: 375/375 files, 5287 tests pass; service-messaging 787, client 695, spec `test:repo` 1522, runtime device files 31: all pass.
- Dogfood device file `push-device-registry.dogfood.test.ts` 7/7. Dogfood battery under the verify lock: VERDICT 0; Test Files 400 passed / 3 skipped; Tests 3304 passed / 28 skipped.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 122 derived, 122 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (4 prerequisite refusals rerun green after their prerequisites, named in os-dev-report 6593261698).
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on all 38 touched code files: exit 0.
- CI on `3cabcf90`: 57 success, 8 skipped, 0 failure.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` is untouched.
